title: Veer Akbar Kevain Jeevan Aan Gi
body:
Veer Akbar kevain jeevan aan gi bhen ujri nou das da ja
<<DIVIDER>>
Maar chadyan, Teray ghamane veera, haye na pardees vasa
Veer Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Aye lazmi nayi Akbar, chan veeran, meriyan sariyan man’nae
Mennu tu, BABAY de man kay Akbar mehmal tou aap laha
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Khali gharan day jhandray, kyun khola, kiss nay rehna way’lay
